column1: # v12 -- the two real misses left inside the P2 drift list.
# Everything else P2 flagged was the glossary being narrower than the corpus
# (暴击 for Critical Hit, 酸蚀 for Acid Burn, 农贸 for Farmers Market ...), so the
# glossary was widened instead of the text being bent to it. These two are not
# vocabulary variants, they are the same word rendered two ways:
#   Logs  -> 已燃烧的原木 / 原木 scattered everywhere, but "Add Logs to Bonfire"
#            said 木柴. 木柴 is firewood, a different item.
#   growing -> the status label had just been unified to 生长中, while this
#            sentence still used the 成长 root.
